title: General Settings - Email Configuration
description: Create backoffice route for general settings with email configuration tab. SMTP/Gmail provider selector, CRUD endpoints, DB table, and EmailService integration.

steps.title: DB: Create EmailConfig model and migration
steps.description: Create EmailConfig model with fields: Id, MainProvider (SMTP|Gmail), GmailAddress, GmailAppPassword, SmtpUsername, SmtpPassword, SmtpEmailAddress, SmtpHost, SmtpPort, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt. Run EF Core migration.

steps.title: Backend: Create EmailConfigService
steps.description: Create EmailConfigService with CRUD methods: GetConfigAsync, UpsertConfigAsync, DeleteConfigAsync. Follow existing service patterns from AthleteService.

steps.title: Backend: Create EmailConfigEndpoints
steps.description: Create EmailConfigEndpoints with: GET /api/admin/email-config, POST /api/admin/email-config, PUT /api/admin/email-config, DELETE /api/admin/email-config. Follow InscripcionConfigEndpoints pattern.

steps.title: Backend: Register EmailConfigService in DI and map endpoints
steps.description: Add EmailConfigService to DI in Program.cs and call MapEmailConfigEndpoints().

steps.title: Backend: Update EmailService to use stored config
steps.description: Refactor EmailService to read from DB via EmailConfigService instead of env vars. Support both Gmail and SMTP providers based on MainProvider column. Add graceful fallback when no config exists.

steps.title: Frontend: Add API client methods for email config
steps.description: Add getEmailConfig, createEmailConfig, updateEmailConfig, deleteEmailConfig methods to api.ts class. Follow existing InscripcionConfig pattern.

steps.title: Frontend: Create useEmailConfig hook
steps.description: Create useEmailConfig hook following useAthletes pattern. Expose: config, isLoading, error, fetchConfig, saveConfig, deleteConfig.

steps.title: Frontend: Create EmailSettingsForm component
steps.description: Create EmailSettingsForm component with provider selector (SMTP|Gmail), conditional field rendering, validation. Use Input and CustomSelector components. Follow AthleteForm pattern.

steps.title: Frontend: Create Configuracion page with tabs
steps.description: Create Configuracion.tsx page with Tabs component (Email Settings tab). Import Settings icon from lucide-react. Use BackofficeLayout. Render EmailSettingsForm in the tab.

steps.title: Frontend: Add settings nav item to BackofficeLayout
steps.description: Add settings nav item to BackofficeLayout sidebar with Settings icon from lucide-react. Point to /backoffice/configuracion.

steps.title: Frontend: Add General Settings section card to Home
steps.description: Add General Settings section card to BackofficeHome with Settings icon, linking to /backoffice/configuracion.
